summary: Vendored poker_ai betting is fixed-limit, not no-limit: state.py:184-193 always raises exactly one big blind (doubled on turn/river) and legal_actions caps raises at 3 per street. CLAUDE.md states the project goal is no-limit. Adding bet sizing enlarges the CFR action set and multiplies training cost, so it should be scoped alongside the 52-card move. Detail in REFERENCE_NOTES.md.
